g.text: 0 / 100 / 200 / 300 / 400 / 500 requested CF annotations; 500 paired patient-bootstrap draws per point.
Independent zoomed y scales by cohort. Compare numeric values, not panel heights.
Upper bars: +/- 1 finite-B Monte Carlo SE (delta method); not patient-sampling SE or confidence intervals.
Lower: relative improvement from saved RMSE; no percentage CI. Lines join sampled budgets only; no smoothing.
At budget 0, all five models coincide with DM. Fixed DM across budgets reuses the same 500 draws (local choice).
Fixed-prefix CF budget; failures are not replaced. Reference: observed reward mean proxy, not causal ground truth.
Adapted model set and local bootstrap implementation; Figure 2/7-style layout does not imply identical original settings.
